kind: pilot / mid-work adversarial checkpoint — the violation runs and what they caught

snapshot.note: The violation run is a COMMIT, not only a transcript. `git checkout 6953fd9` and running the two test files reproduces the failure. The four rules in ENFORCEMENT.md's instrument section say a load-bearing claim needs a file-based instrument that has been shown to fail; a commit is the strongest form of that.

preRegisteredFalsifiers.predicate: If the stratmap violation test PASSES at the stub commit, the test is vacuous and must not be reported.
If the county-assessed control FAILS at the stub commit, the fixture is wrong, not the code.
preRegisteredFalsifiers.outcome: FIRED, and it was right to. The control failed on the first run, and the cause was a defect in the test rather than in the fixture or the code. See instrumentDefectsCaught below. This is the falsifier earning its keep: without it the run would have been read as '20 failures, violation confirmed' and two of those twenty were the instrument lying.

instrumentDefectsCaught.defect: Copy assertions ran against raw markup. `expect(html).toContain("From Caldwell County's own appraisal-roll export.")` failed on a row that rendered exactly that string, because React escapes the apostrophe to `'`.
instrumentDefectsCaught.fix: A `visibleText()` helper strips tags and decodes entities. Copy assertions run on visible text; structural assertions (data attributes, test ids) still run on the markup.

instrumentDefectsCaught.defect: The 'no market-opinion vocabulary' regex `/valuation|worth|estimate|.../i` matched `data-testid="valuation-basis"` — the test tripping over its own hook. It reported a violation that no viewer could ever see.
instrumentDefectsCaught.howFound: Same run. It failed at the stub AND would have failed after the fix, which is the tell: an assertion that can never pass is not an assertion.

instrumentDefectsCaught.defect: VACUOUS PASS. 'renders different basis lines' compared a McLennan render against a Caldwell render, so the two lines differed because the COUNTY NAMES differed, not because the bases did. It passed against the stubbed build, where both bases produced the identical claim.
instrumentDefectsCaught.howFound: Reading the stub run's PASS list rather than only its FAIL list. A test that passes when the thing it checks is broken is worth more attention than one that fails.
instrumentDefectsCaught.fix: Both fixtures now render under the same county name, so the basis is the only variable. It fails at the stub with the rest.

AssertionError: expected 'From McLennan County\'s own appraisal…' to be 'From the Texas StratMap statewide par…' // Object.is equality

Expected: "From the Texas StratMap statewide parcel file, not McLennan County's own appraisal-roll export."

violationRunBefore.readingOfIt: Every failure is a non-county basis being labelled as the county's appraisal roll. The county-assessed control is 5 of 5 green, so the suite is not simply refusing everything.

violationRunAfter.command: same, identical test text apart from one expected-string update recorded below
violationRunAfter.testTextChangedBetweenRuns: One expected string, honestly. The 'after' run's first pass had ONE remaining failure and it was a real design finding, not a plumbing bug — see copyDecisionForcedByTheViolationRun. Changing it added one assertion and tightened another; no assertion was weakened to make a failure go away.

copyDecisionForcedByTheViolationRun.finding: After the stubs came off, exactly one assertion still failed: `expect(text).not.toContain("McLennan County's own appraisal-roll export.")`. The stratmap basis line read 'From the Texas StratMap statewide parcel file, not McLennan County's own appraisal-roll export.' — so the line contained the forbidden phrase, as a DENIAL.
twoWaysToClearIt: Loosen the check to distinguish a denial from an attribution.
Change the copy so the phrase is not there at all.
copyDecisionForcedByTheViolationRun.chosen: Change the copy. Three reasons, in order of weight. First, the dispatch's success criterion is 'must not render the county-appraisal wording', which is a ruling to follow, not a constraint to reinterpret once it becomes inconvenient. Second, a substring check cannot tell attribution from denial, and rewriting it to try would have made it presence-shaped and fragile — the exact class ENFORCEMENT.md warns about. Third and most important, the product argument: on an 11.5px muted line the phrase a skim-reader lands on in 'From A, not B' is B, and B here is the false claim this whole lane exists to remove. A sentence whose skim-read is the false claim is not an improvement on the false claim.
copyDecisionForcedByTheViolationRun.result: The stratmap line is now the positive statement alone: 'From the Texas StratMap statewide parcel file.' The non-claim is carried by the heading, which stops saying 'Tax-assessed value' on exactly these records. A new assertion was ADDED forbidding the word 'appraisal' in ANY non-county-assessed line, denial included, so this cannot drift back.
copyDecisionForcedByTheViolationRun.whatWasGivenUp: The explicit correction of a reader's prior expectation. A reader who has seen 'Tax-assessed value / From Caldwell County's own appraisal-roll export.' on one parcel and 'Recorded value / From the Texas StratMap statewide parcel file.' on the next has to notice that both halves changed rather than being told so. That is a real cost and it is the deliberate trade, not an oversight.

openAtThisCheckpoint: TAX_VALUATION_STUDIO_UPGRADE_CUE still reads 'County tax-assessed value is on Studio.' When the server refuses the dollar fields for an under-tier caller it sends no basis, so nothing on this path can know which source the parcel would have served, and the cue over-promises on a StratMap parcel. Fixing it needs the gated refusal to carry the basis, which is a legacy-design-tools change. Named in the source and carried to the close, not silently left.

The change is inert on live data until legacy-design-tools PR #650 merges and a re-bake runs. Until then every live payload resolves to `county-assessed` (the old constant) or `unstated` (an older bake), and no live parcel renders the stratmap arm.
